ARB101.title: Başlangıç Düzeyi Arapçа I
ARB101.description: Modern Standart Arapça (MSA)'ya giriş. Arapça alfabeyi okumaya ve yazmaya, temel kelime bilgisi geliştirmeye ve basit cümle yapıları oluşturmaya odaklanma. Telaffuz, dinlediğini anlama ve günlük iletişim becerilerine vurgu.

ARB102.title: Elementary Arabic II
ARB102.description: Reinforcement of basic grammatical structures, verb conjugations in present and past tense, and expansion of vocabulary. Introduction to short texts and basic dialogues.
ARB102.prerequisite: ARB 101 or consent of the instructor. ARB 102 Başlangıç Düzeyi Arapçа II (2+2+2) 3 AKTS 7 Temel dil bilgisi yapılarının, şimdiki ve geçmiş zaman fiil çekimlerinin pekiştirilmesi ve kelime dağarcığının genişletilmesi. Kısa metinlere ve temel diyaloglara giriş. Ön koşul: ARB 101 veya öğretim elemanının onayı.

ARB201.title: Pre-Intermediate Arabic I
ARB201.description: Further development of grammatical knowledge including nominal sentences, dual and plural forms, root-based vocabulary building, and verb patterns. Emphasis on oral and written expression. Exposure to cultural themes through adapted texts.
ARB201.prerequisite: ARB 102 or consent of the instructor. ARB 201 Alt Orta Düzey Araрçа І (2+2+2) 3 АКTS 7 İsim cümleleri, ikil ve çoğul yapılar, kök temelli kelime türetme ve fiil kalıpları dahil olmak üzere dil bilgisinin pekiştirilmesi. Sözlü ve yazılı anlatıma vurgu. Uyarlanmış metinler aracılığıyla kültürel temaları deneyimleme. Ön koşul: ARB 102 veya öğretim elemanının onayı.

ARB202.title: Pre-Intermediate Arabic II
ARB202.description: Introduction to complex sentence structures such as conditionals and relative clauses. Reading and discussion of short informative texts. Strong emphasis on oral fluency and written expression.
ARB202.prerequisite: ARB 201 or consent of the instructor. ARB 202 Alt Orta Düzey Arapça II (2+2+2) 3 AKTS 7 Şart cümleleri ve ilgi cümleleri gibi karmaşık cümle yapılarına giriş. Kısa bilgilendirici metinlerin okunması ve tartışılması. Sözlü akıcılık ve yazılı anlatıma yoğun vurgu. Ön koşul: ARB 201 veya öğretim elemanının onayı.

ARB301.title: Intermediate Arabic I
ARB301.description: Consolidation of key grammatical structures. Introduction to derived verb forms. Enhancement of reading comprehension through short literary and journalistic texts. Practice in structured speaking and paragraph writing.
ARB301.prerequisite: ARB 202 or consent of the instructor. ARB 301 Orta Düzey Arapça IІ (2+2+2) 3 AKTS 7 Temel dil bilgisi yapılarının pekiştirilmesi. Türemiş fiil kalıplarına giriş. Kısa edebi ve gazetecilik metinleri üzerinden okuduğunu anlama becerisinin geliştirilmesi. Yapılandırılmış konuşma ve paragraf yazımı alıştırmaları. Ön koşul: ARB 202 veya öğretim elemanının onayı.

ARB302.title: Intermediate Arabic II
ARB302.description: Development of comprehension and production of longer texts. Introduction to idiomatic expressions, connectors, and discourse markers. Expanded exposure to Arabic syntax, morphology, and stylistic registers.
ARB302.prerequisite: ARB 301 or consent of the instructor. ARB 302 Orta Düzey Arapça II (2+2+2) 3 АKTS 7 Uzun metinleri anlama ve üretim becerisinin geliştirilmesi. Deyimsel ifadelere, bağlaçlara ve söylem belirteçlerine giriş. Arapça sözdizimi, biçimbilgisi ve üslup kalıplarını ayrıntılı deneyimleme. Ön koşul: ARB 301 veya öğretim elemanının onayı.

ARB401.title: Arabic-Turkish Translation I
ARB401.description: Introduction to the theory and practice of Arabic-Turkish translation. Analysis of syntactic and semantic features in both languages. Practical translation of texts in everyday language, social topics, and short literary excerpts.
ARB401.prerequisite: ARB 302 or consent of the instructor. ARB 401 Arapça-Türkçe Çeviri I (3+0+0) 3 AKTS 5 Arapça-Türkçe çeviri kuramı ve uygulamalarına giriş. Her iki dilin sözdizimsel ve anlamsal özelliklerinin analizi. Günlük dil, toplumsal konular ve kısa edebi alıntılar içeren metinlerin çeviri uygulamaları. Ön koşul: ARB 302 veya öğretim elemanının onayı.

ARB402.title: Arabic-Turkish Translation II
ARB402.description: Advanced translation practice involving journalistic, academic, and literary texts. Focus on stylistic adaptation, terminology, and cultural equivalence.
ARB402.prerequisite: ARB 401 or consent of the instructor. ARB 402 Arapça-Türkçe Çeviri II (3+0+0) 3 AKTS 5 Gazetecilik, akademik ve edebi metinler içeren ileri düzey çeviri uygulamaları. Üslup uyarlaması, terim bilgisi ve kültürel eşdeğerlik üzerine odaklanma. Ön koşul: ARB 401 veya öğretim elemanının onayı.

ARB411.title: Arabic for the Press
ARB411.description: Exploration of contemporary media Arabic, including vocabulary and structures common in newspapers, news websites, and political commentary. Focus on journalistic style, headline structure, and editorial expressions.
ARB411.prerequisite: ARB 302 or consent of the instructor. ARB 411 Basın Arapçası (3+0+0) 3 AKTS 5 Gazetelerde, haber sitelerinde ve siyasi yorumlarda yaygın olarak kullanılan kelimeler ve yapılar dahil olmak üzere güncel medya Arapçasının incelenmesi. Gazetecilik üslubuna, manşet yapılarına ve köşe yazılarına odaklanma. Ön koşul: ARB 302 veya öğretim elemanının onayı.

ARB421.title: Arabic Literary Texts
ARB421.description: Reading and discussion of selected modern and classical Arabic literary works (poetry and prose). Emphasis on stylistic analysis, rhetorical devices, and literary genres.
ARB421.prerequisite: ARB 302 or consent of the instructor. ARB 421 Arapça Edebi Metinler (3+0+0) 3 AKTS 5 Seçilmiş modern ve klasik Arap edebiyatı eserlerinin (şiir ve düz yazı) okunması ve tartışılması. Üslup analizi, söz sanatları ve edebi türlere vurgu. Ön koşul: ARB 302 veya öğretim elemanının onayı.

ARB431.title: Arab Culture and History
ARB431.description: A cultural and historical overview of the Arab world from pre-Islamic times to the modern era. Topics including religion, society, language development, and cultural production, supplemented by authentic materials in Arabic.
ARB431.prerequisite: ARB 302 or consent of the instructor. ARB 431 Arap Kültürü ve Tarihi (3+0+0) 3 AKTS 5 Arap dünyasına İslam öncesi dönemden modern çağa uzanan kültürel ve tarihsel açıdan genel bir bakış. Özgün Arapça materyallerle desteklenen, din, toplum, dil gelişimi ve kültürel üretim gibi konular. Ön koşul: ARB 302 veya öğretim elemanının onayı.

ARB441.title: Modern Arabic Literature
ARB441.description: Survey of major themes, authors, and movements in 20th and 21st-century Arabic literature. Selected readings of translated and original Arabic texts with glosses. Emphasis on critical reading, interpretation, and contextual analysis.
ARB441.prerequisite: ARB 421 or consent of the instructor. ARB 441 Modern Arap Edebiyatı (3+0+0) 3 AKTS 5 20. ve 21. yüzyıl Arap edebiyatındaki başlıca temaların, yazarların ve akımların incelenmesi. Tercüme edilmiş ve (dipnotlu) özgün Arapça metinlerden seçkileri okuma. Eleştirel okuma, yorumlama ve bağlamsal analize vurgu. Ön koşul: ARB 421 veya öğretim elemanının onayı.

ARM101.title: Armenian for Beginners I
ARM101.description: An introductory course in modern Western Armenian: the Armenian alphabet, elementary vocabulary and simple grammatical forms. Elementary readings.

ARM102.title: Armenian for Beginners II
ARM102.description: Basic knowledge of vocabulary, grammar and syntax. Readings of selected passages of Armenian texts.
ARM102.prerequisite: ARM 101 or consent of the instructor.

CHIN101.title: Beginners Chinese I
CHIN101.description: Emphasis on intensive reading, conversation and simple sentence structures in grammar. Listening, writing, and introduction to 100 ideograms.

CHIN102.title: Beginners Chinese II
CHIN102.description: Emphasis on intensive reading, conversation and grammar. Listening, writing, and another 100 ideograms.
CHIN102.prerequisite: CHIN 101 or consent of the instructor.

CHIN201.title: Intermediate Chinese I
CHIN201.description: Emphasis on reading and complex structures in grammar. Conversation and additional 200 ideograms.
CHIN201.prerequisite: CHIN 102 or consent of the instructor.

CHIN202.title: Intermediate Chinese II
CHIN202.description: Emphasis on reading and more complex structures in grammar. Conversation and additional 200 ideograms.
CHIN202.prerequisite: CHIN 201 or consent of the instructor.

CHIN301.title: Advanced Chinese I
CHIN301.description: Reading, grammar, conversation, and writing at advanced level. Introduction to readings in Chinese culture. Use of additional 300 ideograms.
CHIN301.prerequisite: CHIN 202 or consent of the instructor.

CHIN302.title: Advanced Chinese II
CHIN302.description: Extending reading, grammar, conversation, and writing at advanced level. Readings in Chinese culture. Additional 300 ideograms.
CHIN302.prerequisite: CHIN 301 or consent of the instructor.

CHIN401.title: Readings in Chinese Culture I
CHIN401.description: Reading, grammar, conversation and writing. Advanced readings in Chinese history and culture. Learning additional 500 ideograms of advanced vocabulary on history and culture.
CHIN401.prerequisite: CHIN 302 or consent of the instructor.

CHIN402.title: Readings in Chinese Culture II
CHIN402.description: Reading, grammar, translation according to Chinese ability. Readings in classical Chinese literature. Use of additional 500 ideograms.
CHIN402.prerequisite: CHIN 401 or consent of the instructor.

FR101.title: Elementary French I
FR101.description: Introduction to French with equal emphasis on reading, writing and speaking.

FR102.title: Elementary French II
FR102.description: Basic knowledge of French grammar and structure; emphasis on reading, writing and speaking.
FR102.prerequisite: FR 101 or consent of the instructor.

FR201.title: Intermediate French I
FR201.description: Consolidating FR 102; further emphasis on grammar and structure.
FR201.prerequisite: FR 102 or consent of the instructor.

FR202.title: Intermediate French II
FR202.description: Consolidating FR 201; further emphasis on grammar and structure.
FR202.prerequisite: FR 201 or consent of the instructor.

FR301.title: Advanced French I
FR301.description: Practice on grammar, reading, writing and speaking; introduction to French literature and culture.
FR301.prerequisite: FR 202 or consent of the instructor.

FR302.title: Advanced French II
FR302.description: Enchancement of grammar and vocabulary to facilitate writing term papers.
FR302.prerequisite: FR 301 or consent of the instructor.

FR321.title: French Civilization I
FR321.description: Enhancement of the written and spoken French through usage of media and literary texts. Observation of French language-based civilization and cultures through available information tools.

FR401.title: Modern French Literature I
FR401.description: Study of the leading 20th century French innovative poets and writers with special attention to developments in contemporary French literature (Apollinaire; Dada and surrealism: Breton, Eluard, Desnos, etc.; Gide; Proust; Valéry; Prévert). Improvement of written and oral expression in French through presentations and written assignments.

FR411.title: French-Turkish/Turkish-French Translation I
FR411.description: Techniques of translation from and into French. Translational analysis of texts covering such diverse topics as philosophy, social sciences, translation theory and the EU, with related translation exercises. Problems of terminology in translation and comparative work on translated texts.

FR412.title: French-Turkish/Turkish-French Translation II
FR412.description: Techniques of translating from and into French. Translational analysis of texts covering such diverse topics as poetry, the story, literary criticsm and art history, with related translation exercises. Problems of terminology in translation and comparative work on translated texts.

FR421.title: French Culture I
FR421.description: Enhancement of the written and spoken French through broadcast and narrowcast media. Study of French language-based cultures through extant information sources.

FR422.title: French Culture II
FR422.description: Further enhancement of the language skills and knowledge of French culture through texts and similar material on the French intellectual history.

FR431.title: French in Press
FR431.description: Study of the basic concepts of print media in the French language. Analysis of the structure of journalistic text. Use of newspapers, magazines and web pages in French as educational tools. Production of print media texts.

FR441.title: Advanced French Language Skills
FR441.description: IAdvanced French grammar and reading skills. Study of more complex syntactic structures. Developing French Language competence through literary text and articles.

GER101.title: Elementary German I
GER101.description: Introduction to German. Equal emphasis on reading, writing, speaking and listening comprehension, geared to first stage of A1 level of CEFR.

GER102.title: Elementary German II
GER102.description: Continuation of GER 101; geared to second and last stage of A1 level of CEFR.
GER102.prerequisite: GER 101 or consent of the instructor

GER105.title: Concentrated Elementary German
GER105.description: A concentrated beginner’s course covering levels A.1.1 and A.1.2 of the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages. Initiating and maintaining basic social interactions such as greetings, farewells, and requesting information. Discussing everyday topics such as family and activities. Reading simple texts such as notices, advertisements, and instructions. Using basic grammatical structures to complete forms and write simple personal communications. Prerequisite: Consent of the instructor.

GER201.title: Pre-Intermediate German I
GER201.description: Continuation of GER 102. Detailed approach to German grammar and sentence structure; further emphasis on reading, writing, speaking and listening comprehension; geared to the first stage of A2 level of CEFR.
GER201.prerequisite: GER 102 or consent of the instructor

GER202.title: Pre-Intermediate German II
GER202.description: Continuation of GER 201. Detailed approach to German grammar and sentence structure; further emphasis on reading writing, speaking and listening comprehension; geared to second stage of A2 level of CEFR.
GER202.prerequisite: GER 201 or consent of the instructor

GER301.title: Intermediate German I
GER301.description: Intensive instruction for careful reading of texts and further elaboration of grammatical and syntactical features. Equal emphasis on reading, writing, speaking and listening comprehension; geared to first stage of B1 level of CEFR.
GER301.prerequisite: GER 202 or consent of the instructor

GER302.title: Intermediate German II
GER302.description: Continuation of GER 301; geared to second stage of B1 level of CEFR.
GER302.prerequisite: GER 301 or consent of the instructor

GER403.title: Intermediate German III
GER403.description: Continuation of GER 302. Reinforcement of grammatical and syntactical features. Equal emphasis on reading, writing, speaking and listening comprehension. Introduction to literature and cultures of German speaking countries; geared to third and last stage of B1 level of CEFR.
GER403.prerequisite: GER 302 or consent of the instructor

GER404.title: Upper-Intermediate German I
GER404.description: Continuation of GER 403. Reinforcement of grammar and sentence structures with strong emphasis on vocabulary as used in German print media. Geared to first stage of B2 level of CEFR.
GER404.prerequisite: GER 403 or consent of the instructor

GER405.title: Upper-Intermediate German II
GER405.description: Development of B-2 level language skills, including reading and understanding texts such as literary prose and articles on contemporary issues, expressing ideas and opinions on sophisticated topics in both speaking and writing, and following extended spoken discourse such as lectures, TV documentaries, and news reports. Grammar points covered include indirect speech (Konjunktiv 1), passive voice, nominalization, infinitival clauses and participial phrases.

GER411.title: Translation I
GER411.description: Translation of texts, selected from various journals, newspapers and works of literature from German into and from Turkish.

GER412.title: Translation II
GER412.description: Further enchancement of translation of texts on current issues, selected from various magazines, newspapers and works of literature from German into and from Turkish.

GER413.title: German Civilization I
GER413.description: Overview of the linguistic, political and cultural history of the German-speaking countries from the Germanic peoples to 1933. Literary texts and authentic historical documents to investigate historical and political events.
GER413.prerequisite: GER 404 or consent of the instructor

GER414.title: German Civilization II
GER414.description: Overview of the linguistic, political and cultural history of German-speaking countries from 1933 to present time. Literary texts and authentic historical documents to investigate historical and political events.
GER414.prerequisite: GER 404 or consent of the instructor

GER421.title: Modern German Literature I
GER421.description: Reading and discussion of works selected from modern German and Austrian authors.

GER422.title: Modern German Literature II
GER422.description: Further enchancement of the reading and discussion of works selected from modern German and Austrian authors.

GER480.title: – 499 Special Topics in German
GER480.description: Intensive study of a theme, movement, genre or author having special significance in German civilization, culture, literature or linguistics. Topics vary from year to year. Prerequisite: GER 405 or consent of the instructor

GR101.title: Modern Greek for Beginners I
GR101.description: Introduction to the Modern Greek language: The Greek alphabet, elementary vocabulary, basic nouns and adjectives, syntax, the three genders, the present tense and the stem of the simple past tense.

GR102.title: Modern Greek for Beginners II
GR102.description: Introducing more vocabulary and training students to hold simple conversations pertaining to everyday life situations. Emphasis on practicing the simple past tense and the tenses formed from its stem.
GR102.prerequisite: GR 101 or consent of the instructor.

GR201.title: Intermediate Modern Greek I
GR201.description: Gradual introduction of complex vocabulary, intensive oral practice to make the students capable of expressing themselves in more sophisticated issues. Emphasis on conjunctions and the middle-passive verbs.
GR201.prerequisite: GR 102 or consent of the instructor.

GR202.title: Intermediate Modern Greek II
GR202.description: Intensive teaching of advanced vocabulary by means of literary and non-literary texts.
GR202.prerequisite: GR 201 or consent of the instructor. GR 301 Advanced Modern Greek I(3+1+0) 3 (İleri Düzeyde Modern Yunanca I) Enhancing the students' level of reading and listening comprehension skills and training them to produce samples of writing in Greek. GR 202 or consent of the instructor. GR 302 Advanced Modern Greek II(3+1+0) 3 (İleri Düzeyde Modern Yunanca II) The reading of Greek prose from literature, the press, the internet, and the like. Basic elements of the history of the Modern Greek language and literature, its relation to the Ancient Greek language (kathareuousa vs. demotiki), its main periods and representative authors as well as the Turkish vocabulary which has entered into Modern Greek, with expressions and conceptual constructions common in both Modern Greek and Turkish. GR 301 or consent of the instructor.

HUNG101.title: Elementary Hungarian I
HUNG101.description: Introduction to Hungarian language and culture. Equal emphasis on reading, writing, speaking and listening comprehension. Geared to first stage of A1 level of Common European Framework of Reference for Languages.

HUNG102.title: Elementary Hungarian II
HUNG102.description: Continuation of HUNG 101; geared to second and last stage of A1 level of Common European Framework of Reference for Languages.
HUNG102.prerequisite: HUNG 101 or consent of the instructor.

HUNG201.title: Pre-Intermediate Hungarian I
HUNG201.description: Continuation of HUNG 102. Detailed approach to Hungarian grammar and culture; further emphasis on reading, writing, speaking and listening comprehension; geared to the first stage of A2 level of Common European Framework of Reference for Languages.
HUNG201.prerequisite: HUNG 102 or consent of the instructor.

HUNG202.title: Pre-Intermediate Hungarian II
HUNG202.description: Continuation of HUNG 201. Detailed approach to Hungarian grammar and culture; further emphasis on reading, writing, speaking and listening comprehension; geared to second stage of A2 level of Common European Framework of Reference for Languages.
HUNG202.prerequisite: HUNG 201 or consent of the instructor

HUNG301.title: Intermediate Hungarian I
HUNG301.description: Intensive instruction for careful reading of texts and further elaboration of grammatical and textual features. Further knowledge about Hungarian culture, geography and customs. Equal emphasis on reading, writing, speaking and listening comprehension; geared to first stage of B1 level of Common European Framework of Reference for Languages.
HUNG301.prerequisite: HUNG 202 or consent of the instructor

HUNG302.title: Intermediate Hungarian II
HUNG302.description: Consolidation of intermediate grammar and vocabulary; fluency in conversational skills. Reinforcement of communicative skills (reading, writing, speaking and listening) and development of further language functions related to themes both in the Hungarian and Turkish culture. Geared to the second stage of B1 level of Common European Framework of Reference for Languages.
HUNG302.prerequisite: HUNG 301 or consent of the instructor

HUNG303.title: Intermediate Hungarian III
HUNG303.description: Continuation of HUNG 302. Reinforcement of grammatical and syntactical features. Equal emphasis on reading, writing, speaking and listening comprehension. Introduction to Hungarian literature and history; geared to third and last stage of B1 level of Common European Framework of Reference for Languages.
HUNG303.prerequisite: HUNG 302 or consent of the instructor

HUNG401.title: Upper-Intermediate Hungarian I
HUNG401.description: Continuation of HUNG 303. Reinforcement of grammar and word order with strong emphasis on vocabulary as used in Hungarian media. Further emphasis on Hungarian culture. Geared to first stage of B2 level of Common European Framework of Reference for Languages.
HUNG401.prerequisite: HUNG 303 or consent of the instructor

HUNG402.title: Upper-Intermediate Hungarian II
HUNG402.description: Development of B2 level language skills, including reading and understanding texts such as literary prose and articles on contemporary issues; expressing ideas and opinions on complex topics in both speaking and writing, and following extended spoken discourse such as lectures, TV documentaries and news reports.
HUNG402.prerequisite: HUNG 401 or consent of the instructor HUNG 411 Translation I (3+0+0) 3 ECTS 5 ( Çeviri I) Translation of texts, selected from various journals, newspapers and works of literature from Hungarian into Turkish and from Turkish to Hungarian. HUNG 401 or consent of the instructor

HUNG412.title: Translation II
HUNG412.description: Further enhancement of translation of texts on current issues, selected from various magazines, newspapers and works of literature from Hungarian into and from Turkish.
HUNG412.prerequisite: HUNG 401 or consent of the instructor

HUNG413.title: Hungarian Civilization I
HUNG413.description: Overview of the linguistic, political and cultural history of Hungary to 1849. Literary texts and authentic historical documents investigating historical and political events
HUNG413.prerequisite: HUNG 401 or consent of the instructor

HUNG414.title: Hungarian Civilization II
HUNG414.description: Overview of the linguistic, political and cultural history of Hungary from 1849. Literary texts and authentic historical documents investigating historical and political events.
HUNG414.prerequisite: HUNG 401 or consent of the instructor

HUNG421.title: Modern Hungarian Literature I
HUNG421.description: Reading and discussion of works selected from Hungarian authors in the 19-20th century.
HUNG421.prerequisite: HUNG 401 or consent of the instructor

HUNG422.title: Modern Hungarian Literature II
HUNG422.description: Further enhancement of the reading and discussion of works selected from Hungarian authors in the 20th century and from contemporary authors.
HUNG422.prerequisite: HUNG 401 or consent of the instructor

ITA101.title: Elementary Italian I
ITA101.description: Introduction to basic aspects of the Italian grammar. Preparing students to deal competently with a wide range of day-to-day situations in spoken Italian and develop oral skills in simulated contexts. Communicative functions covered: making acquaintance; inviting, accepting and refusing an invitation; talking about leisure time; simple transactions at restaurant, hotel, bank, post-office; filling out a form. Introduction to general aspects of Italian culture like gestures and formal vs. informal contexts mainly through the use of pictures and simple audiovisual texts such as role-play activities for beginners. Geared to first stage of A1 level of Common European Framework of Reference for Languages

ITA102.title: Elementary Italian II
ITA102.description: Focus on selected aspects of the Italian grammar. Emphasis on listening and reading comprehension. Consolidating and improving students’ previous knowledge of key basic vocabulary. Communicative functions covered: talking about daily life activities, timetables and habits; asking and giving street directions; talking about past life events and holidays; talking about the weather. Focus on aspects of the Italian culture like food and sport through the use of situational videos, short video interviews and role-play activities. Geared to second stage of A1 level of Common European Framework of Reference for Languages.
ITA102.prerequisite: ITA 101 or consent of the instructor.

ITA201.title: Pre-Intermediate Italian I
ITA201.description: Review of the main grammatical aspects of A1 level. Consolidating and improving students’ previous knowledge of key basic vocabulary. Introduction to pre-intermediate grammar and vocabulary. Communicative functions covered: asking and giving tourist information; time schedule; talking about past activities; transactions in shops; asking and describing physical appearance and character of people, describing family members and family relations; wishes and holiday greetings. Development of the acquired cultural knowledge through the analysis of selected movie clips and simplified newspapers articles. Geared to first stage of A2 level of Common European Framework of Reference for Languages.
ITA201.prerequisite: ITA 102 or consent of the instructor

ITA202.title: Pre-Intermediate Italian II
ITA202.description: Equal emphasis on reading, writing, speaking and listening comprehension. Communicative functions covered: describing places, people and habits in the past; giving a descriptive background of the past; asking and describing physical appearance and character of people in the present and past; talking about schools and the school system; talking about future projects; asking and giving information about renting an apartment; expressing and describing symptoms; asking and replying about physical conditions and health problems. Development of the acquired cultural knowledge through audiovisual texts, short-movies, selected movie clips and simplified newspapers articles. Geared to second stage of A2 level of Common European Framework of Reference for Languages.
ITA202.prerequisite: ITA 201 or consent of the instructor.

ITA301.title: Upper Intermediate Italian I
ITA301.description: Review of the important grammatical aspects of A2 level. Consolidating and improving students’ previous knowledge of key vocabulary. Introduction to intermediate grammar and vocabulary. Further development of comprehension abilities (listening and reading) and production abilities (speaking and writing) through meaningful contexts. Communicative functions covered: describing people’s physical appearance and character; expressing emotions and feelings to other people; understanding and summarizing newspaper articles on tabloids and crime stories; understanding comic strips; talking about holidays and historic places; describing holiday resorts; talking about local/regional foods and traditions. Development of cultural awareness focusing on topics such as regional identity and common stereotypes. Analysis of selected contemporary literary texts and authentic or partially simplified articles. Geared to fırst stage of B1 level of Common European Framework of Reference for Languages.
ITA301.prerequisite: ITA 202 or consent of the instructor.

ITA302.title: Upper Intermediate Italian II
ITA302.description: Equal emphasis on reading, writing, speaking and listening comprehension. Communicative functions covered: talking about social medias and their influence on leisure time; describing and summarizing shows, theatre plays and movies; talking about different kinds of job, expressing opinions about the job situation of one’s country; getting ready for a job interview and writing an e-mail of self-presentation; asking for help, complaining, explaining personal reasons; writing a complaint letter. Focus on the distinctive geographical, economical and cultural traits of Italian regions and their cities. Geared to second stage of B1 level of Common European Framework of Reference for Languages.
ITA302.prerequisite: ITA 301 or consent of the instructor.

ITA401.title: Advanced Italian I
ITA401.description: Review of the main grammatical aspects of B1 level. Analysis of advanced grammar and vocabulary. Enhancement of spoken and written Italian through the use of media and literary texts. Reading and discussion of selected Italian contemporary literary texts, newspapers articles and essays of a wide range of topics. Development of reading and writing skills on different types of texts: narrative, descriptive, argumentative and expository. Geared to first stage of B2 level of Common European Framework of Reference for Languages.
ITA401.prerequisite: ITA 302 or consent of the instructor

ITA402.title: Advanced Italian II
ITA402.description: Analysis of advanced grammar and vocabulary. Focus on neo-standard variety of Italian language and regionalisms. Reading and discussion of selected Italian contemporary literary texts, newspapers articles and essays about a wide range of topics. Development of reading and writing skills of different types of texts: narrative, descriptive, argumentative and expository. Geared to second stage of B2 level of Common European Framework of Reference for Languages.
ITA402.prerequisite: ITA 401 or consent of the instructor

ITA413.title: Italian Civilization I
ITA413.description: Overview of the economical and cultural changes undertaken in Italy during the 1950s, 1960s and 1970s through authentic material, literary texts and selected movies. Enhancement of written and spoken Italian through selected texts, TV broadcasts and audiovisual material. Focus on some aspects of neo-standard variety of Italian. Geared to second stage of B2 level of Common European Framework of Reference for Languages.
ITA413.prerequisite: ITA 402 or consent of the instructor

ITA414.title: Italian Civilization II
ITA414.description: Overview of the political, economical and cultural changes undertaken in Italy from the beginning of the 1980’s to present time. Emphasis on written and spoken Italian through literary texts, audiovisual material, TV programmes and authentic documents. Analysis of some aspects of neo-standard variety of Italian. Geared to second stage of B2 level of Common European Framework of Reference for Languages.
ITA414.prerequisite: ITA 402 or consent of the instructor

ITA421.title: Modern Italian Literature I
ITA421.description: A general overview of the 20th century Italian Literature Schools. Reading and comprehension of selected works of leading 20th century Italian writers. Geared to second stage of B2 level of Common European Framework of Reference for Languages.
ITA421.prerequisite: ITA 402 or consent of the instructor

ITA422.title: Modern Italian Literature II
ITA422.description: Reading and comprehension of selected works of leading 20th and 21st century Italian writers. Geared to second stage of B2 level of Common European Framework of Reference for Languages.
ITA422.prerequisite: ITA 402 or consent of the instructor

JP101.title: Beginners Japanese I
JP101.description: Equip the students with conversation, reading, writing, and comprehension skills in Japanese. Basic Japanese grammatical forms, daily conversation, with emphasis on the Hiragana writing system.

JP102.title: Beginners Japanese II
JP102.description: Focus on the Progressive Tense (Te-form), dictionary forms of verbs, adjectives and comparatives-superlatives in Japanese. Introduction to the Katakana writing system and 100 Kanji (ideograms).

JP201.title: Intermediate Japanese I
JP201.description: Complex sentence structures; if-clauses, time expressions (sentences with when), and plain versus polite style Japanese. Reading and writing 100 new Kanji.
JP201.prerequisite: JP 101 and 102 or consent of the instructor.

JP202.title: Intermediate Japanese II
JP202.description: Focus on complex sentence structures. Introduction to active and passive voices, expressions of benefactive acts (giving and receiving acts). Reading and writing 100 new Kanji.
JP202.prerequisite: JP 201 or the consent of instructor.

JP301.title: Upper Intermediate Japanese I
JP301.description: More advanced grammar forms and their usages. Japanese expressions; conversations and reading material in Japanese. Introduction of 190 new reading Kanji and 150 new writing Kanji.

JP302.title: Upper Intermediate Japanese II
JP302.description: Humble Form and Honorific Form (KEIGO). Practice in conversation and reading material. Introduction of 105 new Teaching of the third phase of Intermediate Japanese. The use of the reading Kanji and 125 new writing Kanji.

JP401.title: Advanced Japanese I
JP401.description: Advanced level conversations and reading materials dealing with topics in social sciences. Introduction of 80 new reading Kanji and 100 new writing Kanji.

JP402.title: Advanced Japanese II
JP402.description: Advanced Japanese at a deeper level. Advances level conversations and reading materials dealing with topics in natural sciences and technical subjects. Introduction of 80 new reading Kanji and 100 new writing Kanji.

JP403.title: Japanese-Turkish Translation I
JP403.description: Techniques of translation from Japanese literature into Turkish. Translating and providing translational analysis of different literary texts such as poetry, short story, literary criticsm from contemporary Japanese authors. Comparative study on translated texts and methods of solving literary translation problems.

JP404.title: Japanese-Turkish Translation II
JP404.description:
Techniques of translation of texts from diverse areas from Japanese into Turkish.

Translational analysis of texts covering various fields such as economy, politics, art and translation theory with related translation exercises. Further enhancement of translation skills on current issues, selected from various Japanese magazines and newspapers. Comparative study on translated texts. Problems of terminology in translation.

JP405.title: Classical Japanese
JP405.description: An introduction to Classical Japanese for students who have completed their formal study of modern standard Japanese. Lectures and exercises on the phonology and grammar of Early Middle Japanese of the Heian period. Focus on how to read, translate and interpret literary works such as Genji Monogatari or other similar texts of Heian period.

KR101.title: Beginners Korean I
KR101.description: Practice and mastery of Hangul, the Korean alphabet. Acquisition of basic Korean sentential patterns and sound system. Communicative language functions such as exchanging greetings, giving their identity, asking directions, posing simple questions, telling time and counting money. Introduction of 15 elementary grammar items and 600 new expressions.

KR102.title: Beginners Korean II
KR102.description: Introduction of a full range of the fundamentals of the Korean language such as an irregular predicates, past and future tenses, honorific and deferential speech styles. 15 further grammar items and 600 new expressions.
KR102.prerequisite: KR 101 or consent of the instructor.

KR201.title: Intermediate Korean I
KR201.description: Exploration of grammatically complex structures and communicative situations. More irregular predicates, connectives, sentential transformations, and speech styles such as imperative. 20 further grammar items and 600 new expressions.
KR201.prerequisite: KR 102 or consent of the instructor.

KR202.title: Intermediate Korean II
KR202.description: Emphasis on developing further skills in speaking, listening, reading, and writing intermediate level Korean. Introduction to aspects of Korean culture and daily life. Irregular predicates, connectives, sentential transformations, 15 further grammar items and 500 new expressions.
KR202.prerequisite: KR 201 or consent of the instructor.

KR301.title: Advanced Korean I
KR301.description: High-intermediate level oral practices and writing exercises. 40 new complex grammar points and 600 new expressions. Learning to communicate in social situations such as daily activities, interests and personal preferences, as well as food, shopping, and lodging; and to ask a variety of questions on directions, prices, and services.
KR301.prerequisite: KR 202 or consent of the instructor.

KR302.title: Advanced Korean II
KR302.description: High-intermediate level speaking and writing exercises. Exchange of basic information related to work, school, recreation, particular interests and areas of competence.
KR302.prerequisite: KR 301 or consent of the instructor.

KR401.title: Advanced Korean III
KR401.description: Advanced Korean grammar. Reading, writing and speaking on Korean culture, history, customs, folklore and geography. Introduction of a large amount of new vocabulary including some Hancha (Sino-Korean characters).
KR401.prerequisite: KR 302 or consent of the instructor.

KR402.title: Advanced Korean IV
KR402.description: Advanced reading, writing and speaking. Participation in most informal and some formal exchanges on a variety of concrete topics relating to events of current, public, and personal interest or individual relevance. Narrate and describe in all major time frames by providing a full account.
KR402.prerequisite: KR 401 or consent of the instructor.

POR101.title: Elementary Portuguese I
POR101.description: Introduction to Portuguese. Equal emphasis on reading, writing, speaking and listening comprehension, geared to first stage of A1 level of CEFR.

POR102.title: Elementary Portuguese II
POR102.description: Continuation of POR 101; geared to second and last stage of A1 level of CEFR.
POR102.prerequisite: POR 101 or consent of the instructor

POR201.title: Pre-Intermediate Portuguese I
POR201.description: Continuation of POR 102. Detailed approach to Portuguese grammar and sentence structure; further emphasis on reading, writing, speaking and listening comprehension; geared to the first stage of A2 level of CEFR.
POR201.prerequisite: POR 102 or consent of the instructor

POR202.title: Pre-Intermediate Portuguese II
POR202.description: Continuation of POR 201. Detailed approach to Portuguese grammar and sentence structure; further emphasis on reading writing, speaking and listening comprehension; geared to second stage of A2 level of CEFR.
POR202.prerequisite: POR 201 or consent of the instructor

POR301.title: Intermediate Portuguese I
POR301.description: Intensive instruction for careful reading of texts and further elaboration of grammatical and syntactical features. Equal emphasis on reading, writing, speaking and listening comprehension; geared to first stage of B1 level of CEFR.
POR301.prerequisite: POR 202 or consent of the instructor

POR302.title: Intermediate Portuguese II
POR302.description: Continuation of POR 301 to second stage of B1 level of CEFR.
POR302.prerequisite: POR 301 or consent of the instructor

POR303.title: Upper Intermediate Portuguese I
POR303.description: Continuation of POR 302. Reinforcement of grammatical and syntactical features. Equal emphasis on reading, writing, speaking and listening comprehension. Introduction to literature and cultures of Portuguese speaking countries; geared to third and last stage of B1 level of CEFR.
POR303.prerequisite: POR 302 or consent of the instructor

POR304.title: Upper Intermediate Portuguese II
POR304.description: Continuation of POR 303. Reinforcement of grammar and sentence structures with strong emphasis on vocabulary as used in Brazilian/Portuguese print media. Geared to first stage of B2 level of CEFR.
POR304.prerequisite: POR 303 or consent of the instructor

RUS101.title: Elementary Russian I
RUS101.description: The Russian alphabet, basic vocabulary, and the plural forms of nouns. Basic sentence structures in the present tense. Establishing basic social contact such as greetings, farewells, introductions, thanking. Following basic classroom language and instructions. Introducing oneself and others. Reading simple texts such as notices, advertisements, and instructions. Completing basic forms with personal details and writing short notes.

RUS102.title: Elementary Russian II
RUS102.description: Basic sentence structures in the present, past, and future tenses. Case marking on nouns. Asking and answering simple questions about immediate needs and familiar topics. Following simple oral instructions and directions. Describing people, where they live, who they know, and things they have. Reading short, simple texts such as posters, signs, and basic instructions. Writing simple personal communications such as short notes, messages, and holiday greetings.
RUS102.prerequisite: RUS 101 or consent of the instructor.

RUS201.title: Pre-Intermediate Russian I
RUS201.description: Aspect marking on verbs, focusing on verbs of motion. Case marking on adjectives, nouns, and pronouns. Exchanging information on familiar everyday topics such as family, living conditions, occupation, and free time. Listening to announcements and texts on familiar topics. Describing familiar people, educational background, and profession or occupation. Reading short, simple texts such as menus, advertisements, and timetables. Writing personal letters/emails and short texts on familiar topics.
RUS201.prerequisite: RUS 102 or consent of the instructor.

RUS202.title: Pre-Intermediate Russian II
RUS202.description: Aspect marking on various types of verbs, including verbs of motion. Complex sentences with relative clauses and clauses of reason and purpose. Initiating and responding to social exchanges such as invitations, suggestions, complaints, and apologies. Identifying the main ideas of brief narrations such as stories and radio and TV programs. Explaining one’s viewpoint on a topical issue and giving reasons for a particular position. Extracting the main ideas of texts such as newspaper articles on familiar topics, anecdotes, and short stories. Writing straightforward connected text on a range of familiar topics.
RUS202.prerequisite: RUS 201 or consent of the instructor.

RUS301.title: Intermediate Russian I
RUS301.description: Consolidation of basic grammatical forms. Participating in spontaneous conversations to express opinions and exchange information on topics related to everyday life. Following informal discussions on familiar matters encountered in areas such as school, work, and leisure. Describing experiences and events and narrating stories such as the plot of a book or film. Reading articles on familiar topics. Writing simple texts such as letters/emails describing experiences, events, or impressions.
RUS301.prerequisite: RUS 202 or consent of the instructor

RUS302.title: Intermediate Russian II
RUS302.description: Participating in conversations of personal interest and that are pertinent to everyday life and familiar topics. Following the flow of a presentation or conversation on a range of familiar topics. Describing experiences and events, giving reasons, explanations, and opinions. Reading descriptions of events. Writing letters/emails and making notes on familiar or predictable matters.
RUS302.prerequisite: RUS 301 or consent of the instructor

SPA101.title: Elementary Spanish I
SPA101.description: Introduction to Spanish. Geared to first stage of A1 level of CEFR. Development of communicative skills (reading, writing, speaking and listening) with a focus on language functions related to giving information, asking and answering about personal information, physical and character description, family, personal interests, likes and dislikes, descriptions of places and everyday activities/routines.

SPA102.title: Elementary Spanish II
SPA102.description: Consolidation of basic grammar and vocabulary. Geared to second and last stage of A1, beginning of A2 level of CEFR. Development of communicative skills (reading, writing, speaking and listening) with a focus on language functions related to giving information, asking questions and answering about habits and future plans, difficulties and feelings when learning a foreign language, past life and childhood, biographic data, food and meals, restaurants and markets, directions to go to places, comparisons, houses and furniture.
SPA102.prerequisite: SPA 101 or consent of the instructor.

SPA201.title: Pre-Intermediate Spanish I
SPA201.description: Introduction to pre-intermediate grammar and vocabulary. Geared to the intermediate stage of A2 level of CEFR. Development of communicative skills (reading, writing, speaking and listening) with a focus on language functions related to giving information, asking questions and answering about past experiences, leisure activities (travelling, shopping, going to the cinema), education and jobs, opinions and advices, health and going to the doctor.
SPA201.prerequisite: SPA 102 or consent of the instructor.

SPA202.title: Pre-Intermediate Spanish II
SPA202.description: Introduction to intermediate grammar and vocabulary. Beginning of B1 level of CEFR. Development of communicative skills (reading, writing, speaking and listening) with a focus on language functions related to giving information, asking questions and answering about personal anecdotes and reactions to other people’s stories, evaluation of past experiences, summaries of books and movies, instructions and advice, prohibitions and obligations.
SPA202.prerequisite: SPA 201 or consent of the instructor.

SPA301.title: Intermediate Spanish I
SPA301.description: Intensive instruction for careful reading of texts: further elaboration of grammatical and syntactical features. Geared to intermediate stage of B1 level of CEFR. Reinforcement of communicative skills (reading, writing, listening, speaking) and development of further language functions related to making telephone calls and appointments, writing messages, expressing wishes and needs, evaluating social situations and facts, giving opinions about personal and other people’s experiences.
SPA301.prerequisite: SPA 202 or consent of the instructor.

SPA302.title: Intermediate Spanish II
SPA302.description: Consolidation of intermediate grammar and vocabulary; fluency in conversational skills; introduction to Spanish and Latin American literature. Geared to complete B1 level and beginning of B2 of CEFR. Reinforcement of communicative skills (reading, writing, speaking and listening) and development of further language functions related to arguing, expressing feelings and thoughts regarding abstract and cultural themes, talking about people’s character and qualities, relationships, emotions, customs and values both of the Spanish and Turkish culture..
SPA302.prerequisite: SPA 301 or consent of the instructor.

SPA321.title: Hispano-American and Spanish Culture I
SPA321.description: Enhancement of written and spoken Spanish through literary texts and media material; introduction to Hispano-American and Spanish culture through literature.

SPA322.title: Hispano-American and Spanish Culture II
SPA322.description: Emphasis on written and spoken Spanish through literary texts and media material; specific analysis and comprehension of Spanish and Latin American literature.
SPA322.prerequisite: Consent of the instructor. SPA 401 Spanish and Latin American Literature of the 19th&20th Centuries I (19. ve 20. Yüzyıl İspanyol ve Latin Amerikan Edebiyatı I) (3+0+0) 3 ECTS 5 Reading and comprehension of selected works from Spanish and Latin American authors; discussion sessions based on students' term papers. Consent of the instructor. SPA 402 Spanish and Latin American Literature of the 19th&20th Centuries II (19. ve 20. Yüzyıl İspanyol ve Latin Amerikan Edebiyatı II) (3+0+0) 3 ECTS 5 Advanced reading and comprehension sessions; seminars on selected topics from Spanish and Latin American literature. Consent of the instructor.

SPA411.title: Translation I
SPA411.description: Translation of texts on current issues; selected from magazines and newspapers in Spanish; classroom analysis of student assignments of text translations from Spanish and into Spanish.

SPA412.title: Translation II
SPA412.description: Advanced seminar on translation of complicated texts from Spanish into Turkish and vice versa.
SPA412.prerequisite: Consent of the instructor. KRD101.title: Kurdish for Beginners I
KRD101.description: Basic vocabulary and sentence structures in the present tense in the Kurmanci dialect. Following basic classroom instructions and using key phrases for classroom interaction. Making introductions and other basic language functions for daily social exchanges. Reading texts such as notices and instructions. Completing forms with personal details; writing short texts such as notes and descriptions.

KRD102.title: Kurdish for Beginners II
KRD102.description:
Basic sentence structures for expressing the present, past, and future. Asking and answering simple questions about immediate needs and everyday topics. Describing people with a focus on their interests, their jobs, and where they live. Reading short texts about people and familiar topics. Writing simple texts such as short notes, messages, and holiday greetings.

GR 111-112 Ancient Greek I-II (3+1+0) 3 ECTS 5

(Eski Yunanca I-II)

Ancient Greek courses at the elementary level are intended for students who wish to learn the basic grammar of the Ancient Greek. Elementary readings from simplified texts of Greek authors are part of the course work.

Prerequisite for GR 112: GR 111 or consent of the instructor.

GR 211-212 Ancient Greek III-IV (3+1+0) 3 ECTS 5

(Eski Yunanca III-IV)

Ancient Greek courses at the intermediate level are a continuation of GR 101-102. The courses include further study of irregular verbs, of the subjunctive and the optative, as well as an analysis of various syntactical phenomena. Reading of prose passages from major Greek authors is part of the course work.
KRD102.prerequisite: GR 112 / GR 211 or consent of the instructor. GR 311 Ancient Greek V (3+0+0) 3 (Eski Yunanca V) An advanced course in Ancient Greek offering intensive instruction through close reading of prescribed texts. Further elaboration on grammatical and syntactical features when necessary. GR 212 or consent of the instructor. GR 312 Ancient Greek VI (3+0+0) 3 (Eski Yunanca VI) An in-depth study of a prescribed author (of the Classical or the Byzantine period) or an anthology of Greek prose to help students enhance their skills in handling sophisticated texts in Ancient Greek. GR 311 or consent of the instructor.

LAT111.title: Elementary Latin I
LAT111.description: Introduction to basic Latin syntax, grammar and preliminary vocabulary, with reading of brief passages from Latin authors.

LAT112.title: Elementary Latin II
LAT112.description: A continuation of LAT 111; completion of basic grammar with increased facility in reading through selected passages of Latin poetry and prose.
LAT112.prerequisite: LAT 111 or consent of the instructor.

LAT211.title: Intermediate Latin I
LAT211.description: Consolidation of the Latin forms and syntax. Emphasis on reading comprehension through the translation of unadapted excerpts from various Latin texts.
LAT211.prerequisite: LAT 112 or consent of the instructor.

LAT212.title: Intermediate Latin II
LAT212.description: Reinforcement of grammar. Focus on translation skills through the study of a large sample of classical and medieval Latin texts and the cursory reading of an unabridged work in Latin.
LAT212.prerequisite: LAT 211 or consent of the instructor. LAT 311 Advanced Latin I (3+0+0) 3 (İleri Düzeyde Latince I) Enhancing of the translation skills and further reinforcement of grammar. Special emphasis on the historical and literary contexts of the texts studied. LAT 212 or consent of the instructor. LAT 312 Advanced Latin II (3+0+0) 3 (İleri Düzeyde Latince II) Translating complex texts with continued emphasis upon the cultural context of these works. An introduction to epigraphy and Church Latin to enhance translation skills acquired previously. LAT 311 or consent of the instructor.

PER201.title: Persian I
PER201.description: The alphabet, word structure, phology and morphology of Persian. An applied study on selected texts from classical and modern Persian works. Persian elements in Ottoman Turkish.

PER202.title: Persian II
PER202.description: Word groups, word types and sentence structure (syntax) of Persian. An applied study on selected texts from classical and modern Persian works. Persian expressions, compounds and quoted sentences used in Ottoman Turkish.

PER203.title: Persian III
PER203.description: Classical forms and usages in Persian. Selected readings in medieval and early modern texts. Persian influences on Ottoman literature.
PER203.prerequisite: PER 202 or Consent of the instructor.

PER204.title: Persian IV
PER204.description: Forms, themes and tropes in classical Persian poetry, including panegyric, epic and didactic mysticism. Parallels with Ottoman poetry.
PER204.prerequisite: PER 203 or Consent of the instructor.
